why: At Livewire, we provide a wide range of state-of-the-art technology integration services and prides itself on quality products, quality installation, and excellent customer service. We’ve been making technology simple for our clients for over 20 years.

Livewire is officially a licensed Class A contractor. This certification underscores our dedication to maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, quality, and safety in all our projects. With this advanced qualification, we are authorized and fully equipped to manage complex and large-scale installations, ensuring our clients receive exceptional service and expertise for all their low or high voltage requirements.

Through hard work, honesty, and quality craftsmanship, Livewire has become the premier technology integrator in Central Virginia. Livewire’s installation and service techs have years of experience and a wide range of technological, construction, and electronic certifications. The quality of their craftsmanship is the reason 80% of Livewire’s business comes through customer referrals.
intro_after: Livewire will carefully remove and de-install all specified existing equipment and will return it to the client unless otherwise requested. We will also re-dress and organize all wiring in each location for improved cable management and visual appearance.
